statements: The wallet selector leaves out Byron wallets and disables wallets that are still syncing. The chosen DRep, Abstain or No Confidence is shown with a Change button that returns to the Directory.

Submit is disabled while the wallet already delegates to the chosen option. On a build without the CIP-30 dApp connector, Submit prepares the transaction and opens the confirmation dialog with its fee, or shows an error such as the wallet lacking the minimum amount of ADA. On a build with the connector, Submit sends the delegation through the shared transaction review.
